task: Task 10 - ModelCallLog batch and timeout observability
assertions: QA success logs preserve run_id, batch_id, batch_index, latency, input character count, estimated input tokens, output character count, and an empty provider-only token_usage object.
QA retry and split diagnostics are stored in retry_count and split_depth instead of token_usage.
ProviderError endpoint, model snapshot, and timeout phase are persisted without storing the prompt or complete model output.
Connection-test logs retain run_id=None and record the selected model snapshot, endpoint, and timeout phase.
Model-call logs can be filtered by runId, batchId, timeoutPhase, providerId, and modelConfigId.
Model-call API responses expose the new fields while retaining the existing provider, model, status, latency, token usage, error, and request fields.
Endpoint and error-message values are redacted before being returned, including sensitive URL parameters.

ruff.command: ruff check server/app/models/model_config.py server/app/repositories/model_call_log_repo.py server/app/services/qa_split_service.py server/app/services/model_config_service.py server/app/services/log_query_service.py server/app/schemas/logs.py server/app/api/v1/logs.py server/app/core/log_redaction.py server/tests/test_logs_observability.py server/tests/test_qa_split_task.py server/tests/test_model_config.py

safety: QA prompt text, complete model output, PDF source text, and API keys are not written to ModelCallLog.
token_usage remains reserved for provider-returned numeric usage fields.
